name: RSI Alert
summary: This EA monitors the RSI (Relative Strength Index) indicator and generates alert notifications when RSI crosses user-defined overbought and oversold threshold levels. It is a signal/alert utility that does not open any trades itself, serving as a monitoring tool for traders who want to be notified of potential momentum extremes.
summary_zh: 这个EA监控RSI(相对强弱指数)指标,当RSI穿越用户设定的超买和超卖阈值时发出警报通知。它是一个信号/警报工具,不会自行开仓交易,为交易者提供动量极值的提醒服务。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于RSI指标的超买超卖信号监测,而非自动交易。入场条件方面,当RSI从下方穿越超卖阈值向上突破时触发超卖警报,当RSI从上方穿越超买阈值向下跌破时触发超买警报。出场条件不适用,因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理方面完全不存在,因为它只是一个监控通知工具。资金管理同样不适用,没有任何下单逻辑或风险控制机制。该工具的价值在于帮助交易者及时发现RSI极值区域,从而辅助人工决策判断潜在的反转或动量延续机会。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is RSI overbought/oversold signal monitoring rather than automated trading. Regarding entry conditions, it triggers an oversold alert when RSI crosses upward above the oversold threshold, and an overbought alert when RSI crosses downward below the overbought threshold. Exit conditions are not applicable since this EA does not execute any trades. Position sizing is completely absent because it is purely a monitoring and notification tool. Money management is similarly not applicable as there is no order placement logic or risk control mechanism. The tool's value lies in helping traders promptly identify RSI extreme zones, thereby assisting manual decision-making for potential reversal or momentum continuation opportunities.

parameters.name: Alert_Type
parameters.description: 警报类型(声音/弹窗/推送)

pros: 简洁实用的RSI极值监控工具,帮助交易者及时捕捉超买超卖信号
参数可配置,允许用户自定义RSI周期和超买超卖阈值,适应不同交易风格
不执行自动交易,避免了自动化交易的风险,适合辅助人工决策
pros_en: Simple and practical RSI extreme zone monitoring tool that helps traders catch overbought/oversold signals in a timely manner
Configurable parameters allow users to customize RSI period and overbought/oversold thresholds to suit different trading styles
Does not execute automated trades, avoiding the risks of auto-trading, making it suitable for assisting manual decision-making
cons: 仅提供单一指标信号,缺乏多指标确认,容易产生虚假信号
没有历史信号回测或统计功能,无法评估警报的有效性
不包含任何交易执行逻辑,功能较为单一,对需要自动化交易的用户价值有限
cons_en: Provides only single-indicator signals without multi-indicator confirmation, prone to false signals
Lacks historical signal backtesting or statistics functionality, making it impossible to evaluate alert effectiveness
Contains no trade execution logic, functionality is limited, providing limited value for users seeking automated trading
improvements: 增加多时间框架RSI确认功能,减少虚假信号
添加信号历史记录和统计面板,帮助评估警报质量
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe RSI confirmation feature to reduce false signals
Add signal history logging and statistics panel to help evaluate alert quality
